name: Days of Memories ~Sekai de Ichiban Atsui Fuyu~
original_name: Days of Memories 〜世界で一番熱い冬〜
source:
The protagonist is a third year kendo student who is energetic and reckless. He has to decide who he wants to spend his Christmas party with this year.

[from [url=http://snk.wikia.com/wiki/Days_of_Memories]SNK Wikia[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名精力充沛、鲁莽的剑道三年级学生。他必须决定今年想和谁一起度过圣诞晚会。

[来自[url=http://snk.wikia.com/wiki/Days_of_Memories]SNK维基[/url]]
